mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GATE_RETRY_QUEUE (ID, ORDER_NO, TXN_DATE, THIRD_USER_ID, CARD_ID, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, MAX_RETRIES, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) SELECT SEQ_GATE_RETRY_QUEUE.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{txnDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thirdUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cardId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING', #{retryCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{maxRetries,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GATE_RETRY_QUEUE WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TXN_DATE = #{txnDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM GATE_RETRY_QUEUE WHERE STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (STATUS = 'PENDING' OR (STATUS = 'FAILED' AND RETRY_COUNT < MAX_RETRIES)) ORDER BY CREATE_TIME FETCH FIRST #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE GATE_RETRY_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING', CONSUME_TIME = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE GATE_RETRY_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'DONE', FINISH_TIME = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE GATE_RETRY_QUEUE SET STATUS = CASE WHEN #{retryCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} < #{maxRetries,jdbcType=INTEGER} THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, RETRY_COUNT = #{retryCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE GATE_RETRY_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'PENDING', CONSUME_TIME = NULL, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND UPDATE_TIME < #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} - INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes,jdbcType=INTEGER} MINUTE
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM GATE_RETRY_QUEUE GROUP BY STATUS
